item.title: Wyandotte school board member resigns following racist comment on Facebook post
item.description: A school board member has resigned from her position after she made a racist comment in a Facebook post. On Tuesday, Wyandotte School Board Trustee Cindy Kinney commented on a Facebook post that said, "dogs or Muslims…you can only keep one." Kinney would then reply, ‘dogs.’ Immediately, an emergency meeting was held by the Wyandotte School Board where they denounced the anti-Muslim post and called for Kinney to step down.
